 Club América 1 – 1 Live 75' Xolos Borja 19' Manoel 12' Live Updated 3 minutes ago America vs Xolos LIVE Score Updates in Liga MX Match (1-1)
 Follow Club América vs Xolos live score, confirmed lineups, match stats, standings & minute-by-minute updates in Liga MX on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Gabriel Garcia Updated October 29, 2026, 12:35 am ET ADVERTISEMENT
 Live Last update 12:35 AM ET 75' Oct 29 12:35 AM ET 3 minutes ago The game is back and forth
 The game is back and forth, but the home team is in control, continuing to dominate with their attacking plays—from the center to the wings—while the Xolos hold their ground in their own penalty area, defending well.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 Key moments
 12:08 AM ET 45' The second half begins. 
 11:49 PM ET Halftime 
 11:22 PM ET 19' Goal by Miguel Borja · 1-1 
 11:15 PM ET 12' Goal by Elias Manoel · 0-1 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 72' Oct 29 12:32 AM ET 6 minutes ago Another substitution for the Xolaj: former Chivas player Yael
 Another substitution for the Xolaj: former Chivas player Yael Padilla leaves the field, and Jesús Vea enters, bringing fresh legs to capitalize on the scoring opportunities that the Tijuana team creates at times on the counterattack.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 70' Oct 29 12:30 AM ET 8 minutes ago There are only twenty minutes left
 There are only twenty minutes left; the tie doesn't seem to bother either team for now, but the home team is controlling the ball better and has threatened with a powerful shot by Brían Rodríguez that went just wide of the right post.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 67' Oct 29 12:27 AM ET 11 minutes ago The Xolos' play has improved
 The Xolos' play has improved; following Gilberto Mora's entry into the game, they are now prioritizing ball movement and looking to attack through the midfield, while América is trying to regain possession and create danger with the speed of its wing players.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 62' Oct 29 12:23 AM ET 15 minutes ago América is pushing hard
 América is pushing hard; they know what's at stake and don't want to give their pursuers in the standings any breathing room, which is why they've made some substitutions: youth academy players Jiménez and Espinoza have come off, and Carlos Álvarez and Kevin Álvarez have come on.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 60' Oct 29 12:21 AM ET 17 minutes ago Following the substitutions
 Following the substitutions, the pace of the game has slowed down, but that hasn't stopped América from continuing to attack in search of more goals, while the Xolos sit back and play on the counter, holding off their opponents' chances.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 58' Oct 29 12:19 AM ET 19 minutes ago Two more substitutions by the Xolos: Rafa Fernández
 Two more substitutions by the Xolos: Rafa Fernández and Zapata leave the field, and Árciga enters the game. Gilberto Mora, number 10, returns to the field after missing the last FIFA match due to injury.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 55' Oct 29 12:16 AM ET 22 minutes ago América also made substitutions during the game to shake
 América also made substitutions during the game to shake things up a bit; Alexis Gutiérrez and Violante left the field, and Óscar Perea and Brían Rodríguez came on—pure explosiveness to fuel the attack for the remainder of the game.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 53' Oct 29 12:15 AM ET 23 minutes ago The Xolos make a substitution
 The Xolos make a substitution, with Joban González leaving the field and Adonis Preciado coming on. We'll see how the border team adjusts, as América is also preparing changes to try to improve its play.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 50' Oct 29 12:11 AM ET 27 minutes ago The match is continuing at a good pace.
 The match is continuing at a good pace. So far, however, it has been the Xolos who have been causing problems for América’s build-up play with their high press, trying to win the ball back in the opponent’s half to create danger without rushing the recovery and giving up space.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 45' Oct 29 12:08 AM ET 31 minutes ago The second half begins.
 The second half begins. The game remains tied; we’ll see how América fares after coming back to tie the game in fine form and dominating play. Xolos has been playing on the counterattack, and they’ve also made a substitution, bringing in Rivero and taking out Boya.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 11:49 PM ET an hour ago Halftime
 We're heading into halftime, with América and Xolos tied at one goal apiece in what has been a great first half, dominated mostly by the Azulcrema, while Xolos has been playing on the counterattack. We're in for a great second half.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 40' 11:42 PM ET an hour ago As the first half draws to a close
 As the first half draws to a close, the pattern of play remains unchanged, with the Azulcrema continuing to move the ball from side to side, while the Xolos are unable to make any headway without possession and are holding their ground in their own half, waiting for the opposition to make mistakes.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 35' 11:37 PM ET an hour ago The goalkeeper is already a star!
 The goalkeeper is already a star! On at least two occasions, Toño Rodríguez has saved Tijuana from América’s relentless attacks as they continue to press hard in search of the lead. The Xolos are struggling without the ball as they’re being attacked with great precision.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 30' 11:32 PM ET an hour ago Half an hour into the game
 Half an hour into the game, the pace of play is picking up for the home team, which continues to mount dangerous attacks down the flanks but isn't finishing them off in the best possible way, while the Tijuana team sits back waiting for counterattacks.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 25' 11:27 PM ET an hour ago The pace of the game has picked up.
 The pace of the game has picked up. Xolos' goal scorer, Elias Manoel, took a shot from long range, but Cota made a fine save, while the Azulcema team is picking up the pace when they attack, looking to score more goals.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 19' 11:22 PM ET an hour ago Goal!
 Goal! Goal! Goal! Goal for América. They’ve tied the game after so much pressure—a nice play inside the box—Borja positioned himself well, using his body to win the ball, and fired a right-footed shot across the goal to tie it up.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 17' 11:19 PM ET an hour ago América's play in midfield is gradually improving
 América's play in midfield is gradually improving; they're moving the ball patiently after the goal that caught them off guard and are looking to pick up the pace in their favor, while the Xolos sit back and wait in their own quarter of the field.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 12' 11:15 PM ET an hour ago Goal!
 Goal! Goal! Goal! Goal! Goal by the Xolos! They scored the first goal on a counterattack after América made some mistakes in midfield; the Xolos capitalized, and following a good pass, Elias Manoel finished it off nicely.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10' 11:13 PM ET an hour ago The home team continues to dominate
 The home team continues to dominate, though at a slower pace than at the start; it’s the Azulcrema who are in control, but so far, the Xolos’ game plan—not worrying about having possession and playing directly on the counterattack—isn’t causing them any trouble.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 5' 11:11 PM ET an hour ago The game got off to a fast start.
 The game got off to a fast start. The Águilas had the first dangerous chance after a play down the left flank; Borja sent in a cross, and a header followed, but Toño Rodríguez made a great save to keep the Xolos in the game. 
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 1' 11:02 PM ET 2 hours ago The ball is rolling at Banorte Stadium!
 The ball is rolling at Banorte Stadium! América and Xolos de Tijuana are already playing their postponed match from Week 7 of the 2026 Liga MX Apertura. A great matchup is in store—let’s see how it plays out between these two teams, both of which are in playoff contention.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:56 PM ET 2 hours ago All set for kickoff
 The players are already on the field going through the pre-game protocol. América and Tijuana are getting ready to play their postponed match from Matchday 7 of the 2026 Apertura. Stay tuned to this broadcast—a great game is coming up!
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:53 PM ET 2 hours ago Xolos' Starting XI
 For the border team, these are the 11 players Sebastián Abreu is starting in their away game against the league leaders, with Gilberto Mora returning from injury to the bench:

 10:46 PM ET 2 hours ago They're already warming up
 Players from both teams are already doing their pre-game warm-ups ahead of the kickoff. We'll see which team—América or Xolos—gets off to a better start. It's going to be a great matchup that will begin in just a few minutes, and we'll know the starting lineups any moment now. Stay tuned for our live coverage!
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:43 PM ET 2 hours ago The standings could shift
 Beyond the three points at stake, this matchup represents an opportunity for both teams to take advantage of the postponed game from Week 7. América could reach 30 points and extend its lead over its pursuers to four points, while Tijuana would have the chance to reach 23 points and remain in playoff contention.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:40 PM ET 2 hours ago Club América vs Xolos Live Score, Confirmed Lineups & Match Stats
 Follow Club América vs Xolos live score , confirmed starting XI and lineups, real-time goals, match stats, Liga MX standings and minute-by-minute highlights from Estadio Banorte on VAVEL.
 Live updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10:39 PM ET 2 hours ago Banorte Stadium Is Ready
 Everything is set at Banorte Stadium for this match between América and Tijuana. The team from the capital will look to capitalize on its home-field advantage to take an important step in the race for first place, although it will face an opponent that is coming in motivated after a convincing victory in the previous matchday.
